title: Nice white, wrinkled, large weave..
text:
Nice white, wrinkled, large weave... Good white color , sown nice.
I washed this tablecloth, and put it in the dryer with a dryer sheet. It did shrink a bit, no problem for my table.
It came out soft, but wrinkled . If I was having a nice dinner party I would have to iron this. It is also a larger weave.
I think its more for casual dinning. Luncheons ect.
